item.title: About
item.description:
Insider Flow tracks two things, both sourced directly from the SEC’s public EDGAR filing system:

  • Insider buying — open-market purchases of company stock by officers, directors, and large beneficial owners, disclosed on Form 4.
  • After-hours filings — Form 8-K material-event disclosures, which companies frequently file right after the market closes: earnings, executive changes, financing, M&A, and other events they’re required to report.

Every figure on this site — shares, prices, dates, filer names, item numbers — comes from the filing itself, not a summary or a data vendor. Where a filing is ambiguous or thin on detail, that’s stated plainly rather than filled in with a guess.

item.title: After the Bell: General Dynamics Adds a Board Member, OneMain Prices $600M in Notes
item.description:
Companies frequently file Form 8-K material-event disclosures right after the market closes, once the day’s trading is done. Two from Friday afternoon worth a plain-language read.

General Dynamics: a new board member, filed under Item 5.02

General Dynamics Corporation filed an 8-K disclosing that its board elected Danny Deep as a new director, effective August 5, 2026. Per the filing, Deep currently serves as the company’s president and won’t receive additional compensation for the board seat. The filing states there’s no arrangement or understanding tied to the appointment, and that Deep hasn’t yet been assigned to a board committee. A press release announcing the appointment is attached as an exhibit.

item.title: After the Bell: Kensington's SPAC Merger Update, a Board Departure at SideChannel, and Severance Changes at Covenant Logistics
item.description:
Five companies filed Form 8-Ks within a six-minute window after the close on August 7, 2026, all between 5:25 PM and 5:31 PM Eastern.

Company Item(s) Filed (ET)
NexMetals Mining Corp. 7.01, 9.01 5:30:48 PM
Covenant Logistics Group, Inc. 5.02 5:27:41 PM
ServisFirst Bancshares, Inc. 7.01, 9.01 5:26:39 PM
Kensington Capital Acquisition Corp. VI 8.01, 9.01 5:25:50 PM
SideChannel, Inc. 5.02 5:25:20 PM

Kensington Capital Acquisition Corp. VI: SPAC deal update (Item 8.01)

Item 8.01 is the catch-all “other events” category, used when a company wants to disclose something material that doesn’t fit neatly into the SEC’s other checkboxes. Kensington, a Cayman Islands SPAC, used it to update investors on its pending business combination with Nth Cycle, Inc., a Delaware corporation. The underlying Business Combination Agreement was signed July 21, 2026, involving Kensington, Nth Cycle, two merger subsidiaries (Homeland Merger Sub, Inc. and Homeland Merger Sub II, LLC), and Kensington Capital Sponsor VI LLC.

item.title: After the Bell: USA Rare Earth Completes TMRC Merger, Uranium Royalty Adds Two Directors, AIxCrypto Q2 Results, Microvast Names New CAO, MGP Ingredients Amends Credit Agreement
item.description:
Overview of Recent SEC Form 8-K Filings

This recap covers Form 8-K filings made with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on August 7, 2026, covering a completed merger, board appointments, quarterly results, an executive hire, and a credit agreement amendment.

USA Rare Earth, Inc.: Completion of TMRC Merger

Items Disclosed: Item 2.01, Item 9.01 Filed: August 7, 2026

USA Rare Earth, Inc. (USAR) completed its previously disclosed merger with Texas Mineral Resources Corp. (TMRC) on August 7, 2026, under the Agreement and Plan of Merger originally entered March 4, 2026. The transaction was structured as two mergers: Hamer Merger Sub, Inc. merged into TMRC, with TMRC surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of USAR, followed by a merger of Hamer Merger Sub, LLC into that surviving corporation.
